write_up: Your data analyst resume is strong! At Carolina Home Goods, you connect SQL and Power BI work to reports and merchandising decisions. That's more useful to an analytics recruiter than a list of tools alone. This posting, though, is for a medical-surgical nurse, and your resume doesn't show the required nursing qualifications.

The SQL model is a great model for the rest: it names what you built and the manual report it replaced. Your current work leads, followed by your earlier insurance analysis and statistics degree, so an analytics recruiter can follow your path quickly.

For analytics roles, start by naming the subjects of your ad hoc analyses. For this nursing role, add your RN license, certifications and clinical experience only if you have them. Your resume isn't the main obstacle to an analytics application, but the nursing posting calls for a different professional background.
